description: This file defines a utility enum 'VoiceWakePreferences' that manages voice wake command settings, including default trigger words, decoding from JSON, loading/saving to user defaults, and sanitizing trigger words.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggers(from:)
methods.description: Decodes trigger words from a JSON string payload.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggers(from: Data)
methods.description: Decodes trigger words from Data, expecting JSON format.

methods.name: loadTriggerWords
methods.description: Loads trigger words from user defaults or returns defaults if not set.

methods.name: saveTriggerWords(_:)
methods.description: Saves the provided trigger words array to user defaults.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWords(_:)
methods.description: Cleans and limits trigger words to max count and length, replacing empty results with defaults.

methods.name: displayString(for:)
methods.description: Returns a string representation of trigger words, sanitized and joined.
